local_review.finding_body: The build enabled both `http` and `https`, but FS-test-contract.2.7 and Review Signal #12 require every Native Image flag to be the narrowest necessary option. A no-flag Native Image run failed only in CXF's HTTPConduit path with `MalformedURLException: unknown protocol: http`; all HTTPS scenarios passed, proving that `https` was unnecessary while CXF's runtime HTTP URL construction still requires `http`.
local_review.finding_title: URL protocol build flag enabled an unnecessary HTTPS protocol
local_review.fix_note: Narrowed `--enable-url-protocols=http,https` to `--enable-url-protocols=http`. Verified the no-flag failure mechanism, then passed full coordinate tests under current defaults and `future-defaults-all` (five JVM and five Native Image tests in each lane), `pullAllowedDockerImages`, `validateIndexFiles`, `checkMetadataFiles`, `checkstyle`, `spotlessCheck`, `generateLibraryStats`, `validateLibraryStats`, `git diff --check`, and `fissile check --staged`; regenerated stats remained unchanged at 20/25 covered calls (80%).
local_review.review_comment: The required changed-metadata run 39437687188 was cancelled by its five-minute job timeout while Gradle was compiling the matrix task, after checkout alone took 4m22s; no contribution error was reported, and the exact matrix command now succeeds locally in 7s with all three expected lanes. The complete single-coordinate review found one contribution-local build-flag issue, repaired it, and confirmed the resulting tests, metadata/index validation, style, statistics, 80% dynamic-access coverage, and current/future Native Image lanes are ready.
